title: Investigating Subtler Biases in LLMs: Ageism, Beauty, Institutional, and Nationality Bias in Generative Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring bias in four specific social dimensions: age, beauty, academic institution, and nationality. While it acknowledges existing research into overt biases like religion or race, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, ethics, or morals as part of its own dataset or experimental framework.
